title: File:A part of the Kareng Ghor in Assam.jpg
author: Joli Rumi
description: A part of Kareng Ghor- Ahom Raja's Palace situated at Garhgaon(Gargaon) which is around 15 kms away from Sivasagar Town in Assam. The present multistoried edifice was built by king Rajeswar Singha in 1752 AD.
period_note: Surviving masonry predominantly 18th century; not direct evidence for a 15th-century palace
classification_note: Classified from source title/category; not a full visual authentication.
